links.outcome: Effect of temperature (output variability) on LLM-expert agreement in Naranjo causality assessment
links.effect: Temperature showed no systematic population-level effect (beta = 0.002, p = 0.959); case-specific EWACS-guided temperature optimization improved classification agreement from 45.0% to 72.0% (+27 pp).
links.quote: Temperature showed no systematic population-level effect (\b{eta} = 0.002, p = 0.959).
